title: Primary evidence for 41 exact Invesco/Nippon distribution-option unit-basis candidates and 48 exclusions
status: Primary-supported research ledger; production integration and replay are tracked separately.

provenance.selectionRule: Exact official open-ended roster plus independently verified catalogue membership, finite positive NAV dated within the preceding 30 UTC days inclusive and not in the future. Recent selection does not truncate historical review.
provenance.discoveryCheckpointQualification: Historical research cohort only; current eligibility and full-series evidence here use checkpoint 257.

interpretation.isinGrowthFieldMeaning: Existing archive field name. In this distribution cohort a non-null value identifies payout; it does not make the option Growth. Nulls are exact identity constraints.
interpretation.originalVersusExtractedSourceHashes: originalBytesSha256 is present only when original bytes were captured and rehashed. textCaptureSha256 identifies extracted primary-source JSON, not original PDF bytes.
interpretation.seriesValidation: All retained observations were parsed as real calendar dates and positive finite decimal NAVs; duplicates/conflicts were rejected. Adjacent move gate is ratio >1.4+1e-12 or <0.6-1e-12. Each candidate has exactly one documented event and zero unexplained moves after the fixed factor.
interpretation.preservedData: Calculation copy only. Raw NAVs, raw warnings, every retained date, distribution movements and historical gaps remain. No interpolation, deletion or distribution-adjusted total-return claim.
interpretation.gaps: gapsOver7Days lists retained observation intervals, not an exchange holiday calendar. No complete historical coverage or inception-completeness claim.
sourceLimitations: Invesco May/October 2013 and 2018 original issuer PDF requests returned HTTP 403. Their primary text extractions retain exact source/page evidence; no original byte hash or visual inspection is claimed for these PDFs. No 403 endpoint was bypassed or repeatedly requested.
The October 2013 issuer factsheet confirms the February 2011 action retrospectively; it is not described as the original 2011 announcement.
Invesco 2016 notices and 2024 footnotes are primary text captures with no reliable PDF page anchor exposed; their exact document/date/section is identified.
CDSL requests for several Invesco identities and the Nippon weekly pair returned HTTP 403; no CDSL contents support this ledger. Successful issuer/NSE/NCCL sources establish the included identities.
interpretation.inputQualityVerified: Every retained date is calendar-valid and unique, every retained NAV is finite and positive, and invalid, duplicate and conflicting observation counts are all zero.
interpretation.preservationChecksPassed: All raw dates, non-boundary adjacent returns, source NAVs and source warnings remain unchanged; only the calculation copy is scaled at the declared unit boundary.
